intro: A chef resume that shows the kitchens you ran, covers a night, the food you are known for, and the costs you kept in line.
tips: Give the kitchen's size: covers, brigade, style.
Show menus you created and any awards or reviews.
Mention food cost, waste and hygiene results.

basics.name: Antoine Moreau
basics.label: Head Chef
basics.summary: Head chef with twelve years in French and modern European kitchens. I run calm, clean kitchens, cook seasonally and keep food cost under 28%.

work.name: Maison Garnier
work.summary: Bistro, 90 covers a night, brigade of 8.
highlights: Write a seasonal menu that changes every six weeks; the restaurant gained a Bib Gourmand in 2022.
Brought food cost from 34% to 27% with better buying and less waste.
Top hygiene rating at every inspection.

work.name: Le Comptoir
highlights: Ran the kitchen on the head chef's days off and led the sauce section.
